tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('inventory.csv')

ebs_waste = df[(df['resource_kind']=='ebs_volume') & (df['state']=='available')]
eip_waste = df[(df['resource_kind']=='elastic_ip') & (df['state']=='unassociated')]
ec2_waste = df[(df['resource_kind']=='ec2_instance') & (df['state']=='running')
               & (df['avg_cpu_pct_14d'] < 2) & (df['max_network_mb_14d'] < 5)]
lb_waste = df[(df['resource_kind']=='load_balancer') & (df['requests_14d']==0)]

print(len(ebs_waste), ebs_waste['monthly_cost_usd'].sum())
print(len(eip_waste), eip_waste['monthly_cost_usd'].sum())
print(len(ec2_waste), ec2_waste['monthly_cost_usd'].sum())
print(len(lb_waste), lb_waste['monthly_cost_usd'].sum())

total = (ebs_waste['monthly_cost_usd'].sum() + eip_waste['monthly_cost_usd'].sum()
         + ec2_waste['monthly_cost_usd'].sum() + lb_waste['monthly_cost_usd'].sum())
print(round(total, 2))
